design_name: Explicit neighborhood-prior acquisition after OBELiX policy failure
status: exploratory-post-diagnostic; frozen before any sequential result for the new policy definitions
history: The completed UCB null and the stage-1 signal anatomy were known. In particular, the thermoelectric prior alone ranked the first official and hard-OOD hit third, equal target/source rank fusion was favorable, composition novelty was favorable, and positive ensemble-spread bonuses were harmful. These facts motivated the policies below. No result can confirm an OBELiX discovery claim; the goal is executable method selection for later independent validation.

campaign.initial_sampling: same deterministic group-aware sampling as the completed frozen campaign
campaign.primary_endpoint: acquisitions to first true top-5-percent candidate; budget plus one when censored
secondary_endpoints: cumulative number and fraction of true top-5-percent hits by acquisitions 5, 10, 20, and 40
best observed target value and regret to the fixed pool maximum by acquisitions 5, 10, 20, and 40
area under the cumulative-hit curve through acquisition 40
campaign.secondary_endpoint_guard: Secondary endpoints diagnose whether a first hit is an isolated lucky candidate. They cannot override a failed primary development gate.

policies.target_ucb_beta1: completed-policy replication: target mean plus one ensemble standard deviation
policies.target_mean_greedy: iteratively refitted target posterior mean without an uncertainty bonus
policies.composition_novelty: dynamic farthest-first Euclidean composition distance from all currently labelled target compositions
policies.thermoelectric_prior_static: frozen thermoelectric source prediction descending; no target refit affects its order
policies.target_source_rank_fusion: sum of percentile ranks of the current target mean and frozen thermoelectric prior
policies.target_source_novelty_rank_fusion: target-mean rank plus thermoelectric-prior rank plus 0.5 times centered dynamic novelty rank
policies.shuffled_thermoelectric_static_control: thermoelectric prior deterministically permuted across identities before ranking

source_only_screening: thermoelectric_prior_static versus each wrong-source or shuffled control

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction within the two policy-validity contrasts, the four source-only contrasts, and the two incremental-borrowing contrasts
inference.effect: right-policy acquisitions minus left-policy acquisitions; positive means the first named policy saves acquisitions

development_gates.statistical: Holm p <= 0.05 and paired 95% interval lower bound above zero
development_gates.practical: at least 5 acquisitions and 25 percent saved relative to the comparator
development_gates.consistency: at least 60 percent of paired campaigns improve
development_gates.censoring: no higher censoring than the comparator
development_gates.negative_transfer: the shuffled thermoelectric and both wrong-source static controls must not match the thermoelectric source-only result
development_gates.claim_status: Passing is candidate-method evidence only; independent validation is still required

endpoint_guard.thermoelectric_prior_static: fixed source-guided screening, not adaptive sequential learning
endpoint_guard.rank_fusion_policies: adaptive sequential borrowing because the target component is refit after every acquisition
endpoint_guard.new_science: not tested by a top-5 hit alone

claim_guard: The method family was chosen after inspecting OBELiX outcomes. A favorable result can select a method for independent testing but cannot change the published frozen OBELiX null or establish prospective discovery acceleration.
